# Interoperable file types {.unnumbered}

## Saving Bioconductor objects for sharing

Bioconductor objects provide a shared structure for data and metadata within the project.
However, preserving their rich metadata in file formats that remain usable over time and across programming languages can be challenging.

The workflow package [*savingBiocObjects*][saving-bioc-objects] offers guidance on saving and sharing Bioconductor objects, with examples covering common Bioconductor classes and standard file formats.

::: {.callout-note}
A Bioconductor *workflow* package primarily provides vignettes demonstrating an analysis or task, found in the **Documentation** section of its package webpage.
At the time of writing, [*savingBiocObjects*][saving-bioc-objects] contains a single vignette: [Saving Bioconductor objects](https://bioconductor.org/packages/devel/workflows/vignettes/savingBiocObjects/inst/doc/savingBiocObjects.html).
:::


[saving-bioc-objects]: https://bioconductor.org/packages/savingBiocObjects/
